verdict.rationale: ReelMimic is a local AI video-generation app, so an official SDK is a fair question for it, but the evidence pack never mentions one. The npm scripts (post-video, doctor), Markdown style files and an 'Extending' section are CLI and customization features, not official SDKs for programmatic integration, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
